blocking_reasons: The exact 91 POP909 test song IDs are absent from current history and the referenced training metadata artifact was never committed.
The historical report says 903 of 909 songs were processed while also saying seven were skipped, so a seed-only shuffle cannot safely reconstruct membership.
The registry values 0.768/0.720/0.839 are cross-training-seed means, while the committed checkpoint training seed and best epoch are not recorded.
A newly chosen POP909 test subset could overlap songs used to train the committed LStoM checkpoint and would not be a legitimate held-out comparison.
required_to_resume: Recover the exact historical 91-song test membership and the processed-song universe from an authoritative artifact.
Tie the committed checkpoint checksum to its training seed and best epoch, or re-evaluate the exact committed checkpoint once the legitimate holdout is known.
Run LStoM and MidiBERT-Piano under identical binary note-label semantics with per-song abstention/error accounting.
